subject.title: Feature request: Add CarPlay support to the official iOS app

question: Should OpenClaw pursue first-party CarPlay support now, and if so which Apple CarPlay category/entitlement and minimal driving-safe Talk UX should the iOS app target?
rationale: Current code does not implement CarPlay, and Apple’s category/entitlement model plus the driving-safe assistant UX require maintainer product, safety, and release-signing intent before a code PR is useful.

options.title: Design-gate CarPlay Talk mode
options.body: Approve a scoped design/entitlement spike for a single voice-first Talk entry point that reuses existing iOS Talk and Gateway session controls before implementation.

options.title: Defer behind Siri/App Intent work
options.body: Keep this open but wait for the native Siri/App Intent direction to settle so CarPlay does not create a separate invocation model.

options.title: Do not pursue first-party CarPlay
options.body: Close or leave unscheduled if OpenClaw should avoid Apple CarPlay entitlement and driving-context obligations for now.

recommendation.title: Design-gate CarPlay Talk mode
recommendation.body: Approve a scoped design/entitlement spike for a single voice-first Talk entry point that reuses existing iOS Talk and Gateway session controls before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: ngutman has the strongest recent history across iOS release/signing, APNs relay, and gateway connection surfaces that a CarPlay entitlement and official build path would need to fit.
